content.short: dapp provides a CLI for creating Solidity DApps with HEVM and non-RPC transactions for smart contracts.
content.description: All you need for Ethereum development. Build, test, fuzz, formally verify, debug, and deploy Solidity contracts. dapp is built by Dapp Tools and provides an Ethereum Virtual Machine implementation purpose-built for unit testing and debugging smart contracts. This toolchain brings together contract building, automated testing, contract fuzzing, formal verification workflows, and debugging utilities in a single environment, helping developers validate behavior, reason about state changes, and deploy contracts to local networks with confidence.
